messages:
maya_g: quick ops check — we need to finalize the KMS/HSM evidence handover for SOC2 by next Wed. Can owners confirm status and any blockers? :calendar:

samir: I'm the lead for KMS key rotation docs. I have PR open but waiting on infra answers for entitlement matrix. pinging @lee for auditlog pipeline dependency.

tia: I can take the PR review for the docs today. @samir please drop the PR link and call out any sections you want a deep review on. :eyes:

lee: CI is failing on the auditlog ingest test — root cause is a credentials TTL mismatch between staging and the HSM emulator. I put a short-term workaround in the pipeline but we need a config patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auditflow/pull/312 (WIP)

maya_g: thanks @lee. @samir does that PR unblock your entitlement questions or do you still need infra to push a config?

samir: it unblocks docs review but not the evidence artifacts. We still need these items from infra:
- signed attestation from HSM team
- exported key policy snapshots
- auditlog export for Jan–Mar 2026 (s3 path)

ops-bot: Reminder: evidence collection checkpoint in 4 days — run `./scripts/evidence-collect --since 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-31` and upload to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ (see runbook)

tia: copied. @lee can you confirm the s3 prefix will be writable by the compliance role? If not, we'll need a short ACL task.

lee: confirmed for now — I patched the role to include PutObject for that prefix. I'll follow up with a PR to make it permanent. Also opened an infra ticket for automating the TTL rotation with the HSM SDK.

maya_g: ownership summary for tracking: samir -> KMS docs & evidence assembly; lee -> auditlog ingest + infra ACL; tia -> docs + PR review; maya_g -> compliance coordination and handoff. Blockers: HSM attestation (lee), entitlement snapshots (infra).

samir: action items I have today: finish docs PR, add checklist to the PR description with artifacts expected. ETA EOD PDT.

lee: action: land auditflow PR with temporary fix, then submit infra change to rotate creds TTL (will attach links here when done). ETA tomorrow morning.

security-bot: FYI: ISO checklist item 3.2.1 updated — new requirement to retain HSM attestation receipts for 3 years. See https://redwood.run/internal/compliance/iso for details.

maya_g: perfect. I'll update the milestone tracker (https://redwood.run/ops/milestones/soc2-iso) after we have PR links. If anyone can't meet ETAs, call it out now so we can reassign. :thumbsup:

samir: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/compliance-docs/pull/87 — added checklist + artifact list. Thanks @tia for offering to review.

tia: reviewing now, will comment in the PR with suggested text for the attestation section.

maya_g: thanks team — keeping this thread for async updates. I'll ping again if auditors request anything specific.

lee: posted the temporary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auditflow/pull/312 — also created infra ticket INF-2291 for TTL automation.

samir: noted, closing my loop once @tia approves docs and I attach the artifacts.

maya_g: last note — tagging @ops-bot to run the pre-handover evidence smoke test on Monday: `./scripts/evidence-smoke --prefix s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026_q1`

ops-bot: Scheduled: evidence-smoke for Monday 08:00 PDT. Results will be posted to #eng-security.
